mission: Continuously increase the Atlas fleet's ability to operate, recover, verify, coordinate and improve itself without owner relay, while preserving all existing trust, verification and production authority boundaries.

goals.name: OWNER_RELAY_TRENDS_DOWN
goals.statement: Routine work increasingly completes without manual owner routing.

goals.name: SELF_RECOVERY_TRENDS_UP
goals.statement: Recoverable faults are handled autonomously and safely.

goals.name: STRUCTURED_AUTHORITY_DOMINATES_TEXT
goals.statement: Machine-enforced policy, roles and authority references remain the actual trust boundary; text interpretation alone never creates authority.

goals.name: VERIFICATION_REMAINS_INDEPENDENT
goals.statement: VPS3 may define verification subjects/properties; it never dictates PASS or modifies verifier evidence.

goals.name: EVIDENCE_IS_CROSS_NODE_DISCOVERABLE
goals.statement: Authorized agents can retrieve the evidence required to continue work without manual file relay (queue evidence store: `atlas-queue evidence|fetch`).

goals.name: OBSERVABILITY_IS_ACTIONABLE
goals.statement: Material fleet drift/failure becomes visible (`atlas-queue alert|alerts|fleet`) and can trigger authorized remediation.

goals.name: NO_BUSY_WORK
goals.statement: Healthy/waiting systems consume minimal agent/model resources: return NOOP when nothing changed; keep a deterministic precheck; quiet backoff on waits.

goals.name: TASKS_REMAIN_BOUNDED_AND_DEDUPLICATED
goals.statement: Idempotency keys, open-task caps, bounded retries, dead-letter.

goals.name: PRODUCTION_STATE_PRESERVED_WITHOUT_AUTHORITY
goals.statement: Production may be observed, never mutated, without explicit owner authority.

goals.name: HARD_BOUNDARIES_REMAIN_OWNER_CONTROLLED
goals.statement: Protected merge, production deploy/activation, trust-root/CA, fleet-role, credential expansion, public exposure, owner-gated Sentinel probes, governance exceptions, destructive evidence ops stay owner-only; convert to precise durable authority requests only after all other useful work is done.

goals.name: AUTONOMY_IMPROVEMENTS_ARE_DURABLE
goals.statement: Repeated manual procedures become reusable mechanisms (scripts, policy, queue features), not session-specific fixes.

goals.name: ATLAS_FLEET_CONTINUOUS_AUTONOMY_ACTIVE
goals.statement: This is a continuous mission: reconcile truth -> highest-value in-authority frontier -> minimum tasks -> route -> reconcile -> repeat; no work merely to stay active.

owner_frontier_candidates: removal of remaining deterministic manual owner relay

auth_req_status.note: do not repeatedly request unless it becomes the actual highest-value blocking frontier for an active mission

remediation_loop: create an authorized remediation task if needed (policy engine)
route implementation to the execution role
route independent verification separately where required
continue until resolved or a genuine authority boundary
report_to_owner_only_when: new P0/P1 or material trust failure
a genuine owner authority boundary is the only meaningful blocker
a major autonomous capability is completed
the fleet cannot safely recover by itself

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: CURRENT_TRUTH_RECONCILED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Fleet decisions reflect live authoritative reality rather than stale narrative.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: AUTONOMY_INCREASED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: More routine work completes end-to-end without owner relay.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: TRUST_PRESERVED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Role, authority and verification boundaries remain fail-closed.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: SELF_RECOVERY_IMPROVED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Routine faults and stale state require less human intervention.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: EVIDENCE_SUFFICIENT
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Another trusted agent can understand and continue the work from durable state.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: COORDINATION_IMPROVED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Useful work reaches the correct role without unnecessary manual routing.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: RESOURCE_EFFICIENT
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Healthy/waiting systems avoid useless model cycles and busywork.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: PRODUCTION_PRESERVED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: No production mutation without distinct authority.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: OWNER_RELAY_MINIMIZED
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Repeated manual coordination is progressively removed.

mission_goals_2026_09_29.name: TERMINAL_OR_PRECISE_FRONTIER
mission_goals_2026_09_29.statement: Continue autonomously until the fleet is healthy or one genuine external boundary remains.

mission_2026_09_29: Advance the fleet toward a trustworthy, self-directed engineering system: continuously reconcile reality, identify useful work, coordinate the appropriate nodes, remediate routine defects, verify results independently, reduce owner relay without weakening governance. Authority delta: NONE. Historical statuses/findings are non-authoritative context.
